name: quioteframework/replay-pdo
description: PDO-backed cassette store for quioteframework/replay: keeps recorded cassettes in the app's own database instead of a pod's ephemeral filesystem.

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/replay-pdo/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
